name: Cuc Phuong National Park
summary: Give a day to Vietnam's first national park: walk the limestone forest and the old tree. The conservation portal places it about 120 km south of Hanoi, across Ninh Binh, Hoa Binh, and Thanh Hoa, at 22,408 ha, founded on 7 July 1962. An adult gate ticket is 60,000 đồng. Primate, turtle, and night-cart tickets are extra.
dotReason: A full day in the forest, separate from the valley boats
timeNeeded: A day on the visit ticket

notice.title: The gate ticket leaves out the rescue centres
notice.body: An adult visit is 60,000 đồng. The primate programme is 80,000 đồng a person. The turtle programme, and the carnivore and pangolin programme, are 60,000 đồng. The night electric cart is priced for people staying in the park, and a group under five people pays at least 600,000 đồng.

body: The park site and the national conservation portal both call Cuc Phuong the first national park in Vietnam, founded on 7 July 1962 by Decision 72-TTg. They place it about 120 km south of Hanoi, in the Tam Diep range, across Ninh Binh, Hoa Binh, and Thanh Hoa, at 22,408 ha. The gate address on the ticket site is xã Cúc Phương, huyện Nho Quan. Walk the forest from the gate. The thousand-year tree is the frame with the blue plaque on the trunk.

The same conservation page counts 2,234 higher plants and mosses, 135 mammal species, and 336 bird species, and names the white-rumped black langur as the park's emblem. It also names prehistoric caves, including hang Đắng, with traces dated from 7,500 to 12,000 years, and a marine-reptile fossil dated about 200 to 230 million years. Those are the park's own figures.

Buy the visit ticket if the forest is the day. Add a rescue-centre ticket only if you want the primates, the turtles, or the night cart. Online tickets have been sold since 00:00 on 2 August 2024. The centre phones are 1800 5555 88 and 02293.848.006. A standing gate hour was not on the ticket page.

figures.caption: The thousand-year tree, with the park plaque on the trunk
figures.alt: A huge buttressed tree in the forest at Cuc Phuong National Park, with a blue plaque on the trunk

gettingThere: The park sits in xã Cúc Phương, huyện Nho Quan, about 120 km south of Hanoi on the park site and the conservation portal. From Ga Ninh Bình you still need a road transfer. No minute from the station was printed.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: About 120 km south, into the Tam Diep range. The park site and the conservation portal give the distance. They do not print a drive time.

legs.heading: From Ga Ninh Bình
legs.body: By road to xã Cúc Phương. Kilometres and minutes from the station were not printed on the park page or the ticket page.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Board page opened 23 October 2026. Visit: adult 60,000 đồng, student 20,000 đồng, pupil or child 10,000 đồng. Primate programme: adult 80,000 đồng, student, pupil, or child 30,000 đồng. Turtle programme, and the carnivore and pangolin programme: adult 60,000 đồng, reduced line 30,000 đồng. Night safari by electric cart, for people staying in the park: adult 150,000 đồng, child 6–10 years 100,000 đồng, under 6 years 30,000 đồng. A group under five people: at least 600,000 đồng a tour. Hotline 02293 848 006. Two packaged walks, “Bước chân hoang dã”, are 220,000 đồng and 320,000 đồng for an adult and already fold in the visit fee and a cart.
